# Texuli — full agent docs

> Complete catalog documentation generated from manifests (168 components).

## Blueprint envelope

A tree may travel in a blueprint envelope (`"format": "texuli-blueprint"`, `"version": 1`, `"spec"`, `"catalog"`, `"status": "draft"`, `"tree"`). Hosts validate it with `validateDraft` from `@texuli/catalog/validate` and paint it with `@texuli/player`.

Design system (spec 0.10.0, in development, not on npm): the envelope may carry `"designSystem"`, exactly one of `{"ref": "acme@2.1.0"}` (an exact `id@x.y.z` the host resolves, or `"texuli:<theme>"` for a library theme) and `{"inline": {"format": "texuli/design-system", "formatVersion": 1, "id", "version", "name", …}}` (a whole design-system document: colors, typography, shape, space and the other closed sections; never CSS). Never a version range, a URL, a path or a `data:` URL. The player applies it to its root; when it cannot (nothing resolves it, or the compiler refuses it for contrast, targets or URLs), the content paints in the default theme with a notice. Validation reports `check: "design-system"` with codes such as `extends-range`, `url-refused` and `unknown-key` and paths under `$.designSystem`.

---

# Action form

> Groups fields whose submit proposes one named action intent to the host.

- **id:** `action-form`
- **package:** `@texuli/player`
- **tier:** `content`
- **agent emittable:** yes
- **emit:** developer, untrusted
- **group:** `state`

### Use when

- Ask the host to do something with a few named values, such as a request

### Don't use when

- Payment or sign-in: those are host regions

### Accessibility

- A labelled form; invalid fields are marked and focused; the receipt is announced

### Props

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `action` | string | yes | — | — | The action name the host receives. |
| `label` | string | yes | untrusted | — | — |
| `children` | slot | no | — | — | — |

### Examples

#### Request access (`request`)

```json
{
  "action": "request-access",
  "label": "Request access"
}
```

### Related

- [`form-field`](components/form-field.md)
- [`form-submit`](components/form-submit.md)

---

_Generated from the Texuli catalog manifest. Do not hand-edit; regenerate with `@texuli/tools/llms`._

# Alert

> Inline feedback for a page section (status or error).

- **id:** `alert`
- **package:** `texuli`
- **tier:** `app`
- **agent emittable:** no
- **emit:** 
- **group:** `display`

### Use when

- Report a result or problem next to the related content

### Don't use when

- A full-page failure (use error-state)
- A quiet tip in docs (use callout)

### Accessibility

- error tone uses role=alert; other tones use role=status; dismiss is named.

### Props

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tone` | enum(info | success | warning | error | brand | neutral) | no | — | `"info"` | — |
| `title` | string | no | — | — | Optional heading |
| `text` | string | no | untrusted | — | Body copy |
| `hideIcon` | boolean | no | — | `false` | — |
| `icon` | slot | no | — | — | Custom icon snippet |
| `actionLabel` | string | no | — | — | — |
| `actionHref` | string | no | developer | — | Optional action link (URL policy) |
| `onAction` | event | no | — | — | — |
| `dismissible` | boolean | no | — | `false` | — |
| `dismissLabel` | string | no | — | `"Dismiss"` | — |
| `onDismiss` | event | no | — | — | — |
| `class` | string | no | — | — | — |

### Examples

#### Warning alert (`warning`)

```json
{
  "tone": "warning",
  "title": "Check inventory",
  "text": "Three SKUs are low."
}
```

### Related

- [`callout`](components/callout.md)
- [`banner`](components/banner.md)
- [`error-state`](components/error-state.md)

# AlertDialog

> Modal confirm/cancel dialog for consequential actions.

- **id:** `alert-dialog`
- **package:** `texuli`
- **tier:** `app`
- **agent emittable:** no
- **emit:** 
- **group:** `overlays`

### Use when

- Confirm delete or irreversible actions
- Require an explicit choice

### Don't use when

- Informational copy without a choice (use dialog or toast)

### Accessibility

- Role alertdialog; focus trapped until confirm or cancel
- Destructive mode styles the confirm action and warning icon

### Props

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` | boolean | no | — | `false` | — |
| `title` | string | yes | — | — | — |
| `description` | string | no | — | — | — |
| `confirmLabel` | string | no | — | `"Confirm"` | — |
| `cancelLabel` | string | no | — | `"Cancel"` | — |
| `destructive` | boolean | no | — | `false` | — |
| `onConfirm` | event | no | — | — | — |
| `onCancel` | event | no | — | — | — |
| `trigger` | slot | no | — | — | — |
| `children` | slot | no | — | — | — |
| `class` | string | no | — | — | — |
| `errorFallback` | string | no | — | — | — |
| `onOpenChange` | event | no | — | — | — |

### Examples

#### Destructive confirm (`delete`)

```json
{
  "title": "Delete note?",
  "description": "This cannot be undone.",
  "destructive": true,
  "confirmLabel": "Delete",
  "open": true
}
```

### Related

- [`dialog`](components/dialog.md)
- [`toaster`](components/toaster.md)

# Badge

> A compact status or category label.

- **id:** `badge`
- **package:** `texuli`
- **tier:** `app`
- **agent emittable:** no
- **emit:** 
- **group:** `display`

### Use when

- Show a short status or category next to a title

### Don't use when

- A removable filter (use tag)
- A toggleable filter chip (use chip)

### Accessibility

- Never convey meaning by color alone; pair with a word.
- In a catalog tree, set label (or put the word in an inline-text child).

### Props

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | enum(default | secondary | outline | success | warning | destructive | info | neutral) | no | — | `"default"` | — |
| `label` | string | no | — | — | Plain-text badge word, escaped; replaces children when both are given |
| `class` | string | no | — | — | — |
| `children` | slot | no | — | — | The badge word (an inline-text node in a tree) |

### Examples

#### Success badge (`success`)

```json
{
  "variant": "success"
}
```

#### Labelled badge (`labelled`)

```json
{
  "variant": "info",
  "label": "Shipped"
}
```

### Related

- [`tag`](components/tag.md)
- [`chip`](components/chip.md)
- [`inline-text`](components/inline-text.md)

---

_Generated from the Texuli catalog manifest. Do not hand-edit; regenerate with `@texuli/tools/llms`._

# Banner

> Full-width notice across a page or app shell.

- **id:** `banner`
- **package:** `texuli`
- **tier:** `app`
- **agent emittable:** no
- **emit:** 
- **group:** `display`

### Use when

- Announce a global condition (maintenance, trial)

### Don't use when

- Inline field errors (use alert near the field)

### Accessibility

- Same tone roles as Alert; dismiss control is optional and named.

### Props

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tone` | enum(info | success | warning | error | brand | neutral) | no | — | `"info"` | — |
| `title` | string | no | — | — | Optional heading |
| `text` | string | no | untrusted | — | Body copy |
| `hideIcon` | boolean | no | — | `false` | — |
| `icon` | slot | no | — | — | Custom icon snippet |
| `actionLabel` | string | no | — | — | — |
| `actionHref` | string | no | developer | — | Optional action link (URL policy) |
| `onAction` | event | no | — | — | — |
| `dismissible` | boolean | no | — | `false` | — |
| `dismissLabel` | string | no | — | `"Dismiss"` | — |
| `onDismiss` | event | no | — | — | — |
| `class` | string | no | — | — | — |

### Examples

#### Brand banner (`brand`)

```json
{
  "tone": "brand",
```

### Don't use when

- Provide the required accessible title, description or text alternatives.
- Keep data available in the component-provided text or table alternative.

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |

| `hostStep` | number | no | — | — | — |

### Examples

#### Code blocks example (`basic`)

```json

  }
}
```

# Embed blocks

> Validated link previews (URL policy) and embed-app shells. Texuli never runs app JSON; hosts mount via mountEmbed with a sandboxed iframe contract.

- **id:** `blocks-embed`
- **package:** `@texuli/blocks`
- **tier:** `content`
- **agent emittable:** yes
- **emit:** developer, untrusted
- **group:** `content`

### Use when

- Show a deferred mini-app shell where the host mounts after user Start.
- Show an offline link preview with HTTPS-only href (URL policy).

### Don't use when

- Application navigation, account controls or mutations.
- Running untrusted app JSON with innerHTML, eval, or an unsandboxed iframe.
- Relaxing iframe sandbox (especially adding allow-same-origin) or skipping CSP frame-src / postMessage origin checks.

### Accessibility

- Start control is a real button; nothing loads until activation.
- Iframe title (when used) names the embedded app; host must keep keyboard access inside the frame.
- Link previews use rel=noopener noreferrer on new-window links.

### Props

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `block` | object | yes | untrusted | — | Untrusted block data validated by the component before rendering. |
| `mountEmbed` | event | no | — | — | Host runtime after user Start. Prefer createSandboxedEmbedMount (sandbox without allow-same-origin, referrerpolicy=no-referrer, HTTPS allowlist). Host CSP frame-src + postMessage origin checks required; never relax sandbox or inject HTML from app data. |
| `labels` | object | no | — | — | — |
| `oninvalid` | event | no | — | — | Host-provided callback; omit when no host behavior is needed. |

### Examples

#### Embed blocks example (`basic`)

```json
{
  "block": {
    "type": "link-preview",
    "href": "https://example.com/guide",
    "title": "Product guide"
  }
}
```

---

_Generated from the Texuli catalog manifest. Do not hand-edit; regenerate with `@texuli/tools/llms`._

# Breadcrumb

> Hierarchy trail with URL-policy links.

- **id:** `breadcrumb`
- **package:** `texuli`
- **tier:** `app`
- **agent emittable:** no
- **emit:** 
- **group:** `overlays`

### Use when

- Show location in a hierarchy

### Don't use when

- Primary navigation (use navigation-menu or sidebar)

### Accessibility

- nav landmark; current page is not a link.

### Props

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | array | yes | — | — | BreadcrumbItem[] |
| `label` | string | no | — | `"Breadcrumb"` | — |
| `size` | enum(sm | md | lg) | no | — | `"md"` | — |
| `separatorLabel` | string | no | — | `"Separator"` | — |
| `separator` | slot | no | — | — | — |
| `maxItems` | number | no | — | `0` | — |
| `hrefTrust` | enum(developer | untrusted) | no | developer | `"developer"` | — |
| `class` | string | no | — | — | — |

### Examples

#### Trail (`trail`)

```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "label": "Workspace",
      "href": "https://example.com"
    },
    {
      "label": "Notes",
      "href": "https://example.com/notes"
    },
    {
      "label": "Harbor"
    }
  ]
}
```

# Button

> A pressable action control with loading and optional link rendering.

- **id:** `button`
- **package:** `texuli`
- **tier:** `app`
- **agent emittable:** no
- **emit:** 
- **group:** `forms`

### Use when

- Primary and secondary actions
- Submit and reset controls in forms

### Don't use when

- An icon-only control (use icon-button)
- A toggleable filter chip (use chip)
- Navigation that is not an action (use a link or nav item)

### Accessibility

- Real button or link element with an accessible name
- Busy state exposes aria-busy and aria-disabled, keeps focus and blocks further activation
- Rejected href schemes render as a non-interactive control

### Props

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | enum(default | secondary | outline | ghost | destructive | link) | no | — | `"default"` | — |
| `size` | enum(sm | md | lg | icon) | no | — | `"md"` | — |
| `href` | string | no | developer | — | Optional link target (URL policy) |
| `hrefTrust` | enum(developer | untrusted) | no | — | `"developer"` | — |
| `type` | enum(button | submit | reset) | no | — | `"button"` | — |
| `disabled` | boolean | no | — | `false` | — |
| `loading` | boolean | no | — | `false` | — |
| `loadingLabel` | string | no | — | — | Accessible name while loading |
| `autoLoading` | boolean | no | — | `true` | Show pending when onclick returns a promise |
| `label` | string | no | — | — | Plain-text label, escaped; replaces children when both are given |
| `onclick` | event | no | — | — | Activated handler; may return a promise |
| `class` | string | no | — | — | — |
| `children` | slot | no | — | — | The visible label (an inline-text node in a tree) |

### Examples

#### Default button (`default`)

```json
{
  "variant": "default"
}
```

#### Loading button (`loading`)

```json
{
  "loading": true,
  "loadingLabel": "Saving"
}
```

#### Labelled submit button (`labelled`)

```json
{
  "type": "submit",
  "label": "Save changes"
}
```

### Related

- [`icon-button`](components/icon-button.md)
- [`button-group`](components/button-group.md)
- [`form`](components/form.md)
- [`inline-text`](components/inline-text.md)

---

_Generated from the Texuli catalog manifest. Do not hand-edit; regenerate with `@texuli/tools/llms`._

# ButtonGroup

- **emit:** 
- **group:** `forms`

### Don't use when

# Callout

- **id:** `callout`
- **package:** `texuli`
- **tier:** `app`
- **agent emittable:** no
- **emit:** 
- **group:** `display`

### Don't use when

# Canvas

> A whiteboard or diagram as data: shapes, sticky notes, text, frames, groups and connectors on an infinite canvas.

- **id:** `canvas`
- **package:** `@texuli/canvas`
- **tier:** `content`
- **agent emittable:** yes
- **emit:** developer, untrusted
- **group:** `canvas`

### Use when

- Sketch a flow, a map of ideas, a retro board or an architecture diagram people can keep editing
- Lay out sticky notes in frames and connect shapes with arrows

### Don't use when

- A workflow with typed ports that runs: use workflow-graph
- A chart of data: use a chart family
- Prose: use document

### Accessibility

- Painted as an image named by the canvas title, with every shape and connector listed as text in reading order
- Text is data, never HTML; image refs pass the URL policy at the host tier
- Styles are a closed palette of theme tokens, never raw CSS

### Props

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `canvas` | object | yes | — | — | A Texuli canvas: { format: "texuli-canvas", formatVersion: 1, meta: { title }, shapes, connectors }. Shapes: rect, ellipse, diamond, line, arrow, path (points), text, sticky, image ({ ref, alt }), frame ({ title, children }) and group ({ children }), each with an id and x, y, width, height. Connectors: { id, from: { shape }, to: { shape }, routing: straight \| elbow \| curved, text }. |
| `label` | string | no | untrusted | — | Accessible name; defaults to the canvas title. |

### Examples

#### Decision flow (`decision`)

```json
{
  "canvas": {
    "format": "texuli-canvas",
    "formatVersion": 1,
    "meta": {
      "title": "Release decision"
    },
    "shapes": [
      {
        "id": "ask",
        "type": "ellipse",
        "x": 0,
        "y": 0,
        "width": 160,
        "height": 72,
        "text": "Ready to ship?"
      },
      {
        "id": "ship",
        "type": "rect",
        "x": 240,
        "y": 0,
        "width": 160,
        "height": 72,
        "text": "Ship on example.com"
      },
      {
        "id": "idea",
        "type": "sticky",
        "x": 0,
        "y": 120,
        "width": 160,
        "height": 120,
        "text": "Ask the beta testers",
        "color": "yellow"
      }
    ],
    "connectors": [
      {
        "id": "yes",
        "from": {
          "shape": "ask"
        },
        "to": {
          "shape": "ship"
        },
        "routing": "curved",
        "text": "yes"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

### Related

- [`document`](components/document.md)
- [`workflow-graph`](components/workflow-graph.md)

# Card

> A surface for grouping related content with optional link behavior.

- **id:** `card`
- **package:** `texuli`
- **tier:** `app`
- **agent emittable:** no
- **emit:** 
- **group:** `display`

### Use when

- Group related content in a bordered surface
- Make a whole tile a single link

### Don't use when

- A single line of chrome (use badge or button)
- A data grid of many rows (use table)

### Accessibility

- When href is set, the card is a real link with an accessible name
- Rejected href schemes render as a non-interactive surface

### Props

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | enum(elevated | flat) | no | — | `"elevated"` | Visual elevation |
| `href` | string | no | developer | — | Optional link target (URL policy) |
| `hrefTrust` | enum(developer | untrusted) | no | — | `"developer"` | — |
| `linkLabel` | string | no | — | — | Accessible name when the card is a link |
| `class` | string | no | — | — | Extra classes |

### Examples

#### Elevated card (`elevated`)

```json
{
  "variant": "elevated"
}
```

#### Linked card (`linked`)

```json
{
  "variant": "flat",
  "href": "https://example.com/docs",
  "linkLabel": "Open documentation"
}
```

- [`button`](components/button.md)

# Chat message

> One display-only chat message: author, role, time, text and block children.

- **id:** `chat-message`
- **package:** `@texuli/chat`
- **tier:** `content`
- **agent emittable:** yes
- **emit:** developer, untrusted
- **group:** `chat`

### Use when

- Inside chat-thread, one per message

### Don't use when

- Outside a chat-thread
- For a reply box; that is host chrome

### Accessibility

- Renders an article named by author and time; the role is visible text
- Message text is plain text nodes; links pass the untrusted URL policy

### Props

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `author` | string | yes | untrusted | — | — |
| `role` | enum(user | agent | system) | yes | — | — | — |
| `at` | string | no | — | — | ISO 8601 time; omitted when it does not parse. |
| `text` | string | no | untrusted | — | Chat inline subset. |
| `children` | slot | no | — | — | blocks-* nodes. |

### Examples

#### Agent reply (`agent-reply`)

```json
{
  "author": "Fictional Agent",
  "role": "agent",
  "at": "2026-10-24T09:00:00Z",
  "text": "Two items are **blocked**."
}
```

### Related

- [`chat-thread`](components/chat-thread.md)

# Chat thread

> Read-only conversation transcript of chat-message nodes, without a composer.

- **id:** `chat-thread`
- **package:** `@texuli/chat`
- **tier:** `content`
- **agent emittable:** yes
- **emit:** developer, untrusted
- **group:** `chat`

### Use when

- Show a conversation an agent summarized or quoted
- Show a chat transcript inside a report or document

### Don't use when

- The person needs to reply: the host renders its own composer (host chrome)
- The content is not a conversation; use text blocks

### Accessibility

- Renders a labelled section; each message is an article with author and time
- Static: no live region, focus trap or keyboard handling is added

### Props

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | string | no | untrusted | — | Accessible name. |
| `children` | slot | no | — | — | chat-message nodes. |

### Examples

#### Stand-up excerpt (`standup`)

```json
{
  "label": "Stand-up thread"
}
```

### Related

- [`chat-message`](components/chat-message.md)

---

_Generated from the Texuli catalog manifest. Do not hand-edit; regenerate with `@texuli/tools/llms`._

# Checkbox

- **id:** `checkbox`
- **package:** `texuli`
- **tier:** `app`
- **agent emittable:** no
- **emit:** 
- **group:** `forms`

### Use when

- Independent on/off choices
- Select-all with indeterminate

### Don't use when

- A switch-style setting (use switch)

| `defaultIndeterminate` | boolean | no | — | `false` | — |

| `value` | string | no | — | `"on"` | — |

| `required` | boolean | no | — | `false` | — |

| `onIndeterminateChange` | event | no | — | — | — |

# Chip

- **id:** `chip`
- **package:** `texuli`
- **tier:** `app`
- **agent emittable:** no
- **emit:** 
- **group:** `display`

### Use when

- Filter toggles in a toolbar or facet list

### Don't use when

- Navigation (use a link)
- A one-shot action (use button)

### Accessibility

- Uses aria-pressed for selection; must be a real button.

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | string | yes | — | — | — |
| `variant` | enum(default | secondary | outline | success | warning | destructive | info | neutral) | no | — | `"outline"` | — |
| `selected` | boolean | no | — | `false` | — |
| `disabled` | boolean | no | — | `false` | — |
| `type` | enum(button | submit | reset) | no | — | `"button"` | — |
| `class` | string | no | — | — | — |

### Examples

#### Selected chip (`selected`)

```json
{
  "label": "Active",
  "selected": true
}
```

# Combobox

> A text input that filters a list of options, for one value or several.

- **id:** `combobox`
- **package:** `texuli`
- **tier:** `app`
- **agent emittable:** no
- **emit:** 
- **group:** `forms`

### Use when

- Pick from a long list by typing to filter
- Options loaded from a server as the user types

### Don't use when

- A short closed list (use select or radio-group)
- Several values shown as chips (use multi-select)

### Accessibility

- The input keeps focus; aria-activedescendant tracks the highlighted option
- Arrow keys move, Enter selects, Escape closes; empty, loading and error states are announced
- With required, a rejected form moves focus to the input

### Props

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | unknown | no | — | — | Selected value (a string, or a string array when multiple) |
| `defaultValue` | unknown | no | — | — | Starting selection; a form reset restores it |
| `inputValue` | string | no | — | — | Text in the input (bindable) |
| `defaultInputValue` | string | no | — | `""` | — |
| `items` | array | no | — | — | Options as { value, label, disabled? } |
| `loadOptions` | unknown | no | — | — | Function prop the host passes: (query, signal) => Promise<items> for remote options. Not agent-emittable (functions are not data). |
| `filter` | unknown | no | — | — | Function prop the host passes: (item, query) => boolean. Replaces the default match (label contains the query, ignoring case); runs on the trimmed, non-empty query; unused with loadOptions. createFoldedFilter builds an accent-insensitive one. Not agent-emittable (functions are not data). |
| `multiple` | boolean | no | — | `false` | — |
| `disabled` | boolean | no | — | `false` | Not interactive, not submitted, not validated |
| `name` | string | no | — | — | Form field name: submits the value (one entry per value when multiple) |
| `required` | boolean | no | — | `false` | Blocks form submission until a value is selected |
| `requiredMessage` | string | no | — | — | Translated message when required blocks submission (default: the browser message) |
| `form` | string | no | — | — | Associated form id |
| `open` | boolean | no | — | `false` | — |
| `size` | enum(sm | md | lg) | no | — | `"md"` | — |
| `variant` | enum(outline | soft) | no | — | `"outline"` | — |
| `class` | string | no | — | — | — |
| `onValueChange` | event | no | — | — | — |
| `onInputValueChange` | event | no | — | — | — |
| `onOpenChange` | event | no | — | — | — |
| `children` | slot | no | — | — | — |

### Examples

#### Required form field (`form-field`)

```json
{
  "name": "city",
  "required": true,
  "requiredMessage": "Choose a city.",
  "size": "md"
}
```

# Board

- **id:** `data-board`

- **tier:** `content`
- **agent emittable:** yes
- **emit:** developer, untrusted
- **group:** `data`

- Show work items by status and let people move them between columns

### Don't use when

- One ordered list: use sortable-list
- Read-only status counts: use kpi or a chart

### Accessibility

- Columns are labelled lists; each card has a drag handle button and a "Move to…" menu (the non-drag path)
- Moves are announced politely with column and position; locked cards refuse moves with a reason

### Props

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | string | yes | untrusted | — | Accessible name of the view. |
| `columns` | array | yes | — | — | — |
| `items` | array | yes | — | — | Cards: each names its column (and lane); rank orders cards within a cell. |
| `lanes` | array | no | — | — | — |
| `density` | enum(comfortable | compact) | no | — | — | — |

```json
      "id": "doing",
      "title": "In progress",
      "wipSoft": 2
    },
    {
      "id": "done",
      "title": "Done"
    }
  ],
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "t1",
      "title": "Draft the release notes",
      "column": "todo",
      "rank": "a0"
    },
    {
      "id": "t2",
      "title": "Review the onboarding flow",
      "column": "doing",
```

# Cohort table

> A retention table: one row per cohort, one column per period after it started, as rates or counts, with optional heat tints and an averages row.

- **id:** `data-cohort-table`
- **package:** `@texuli/data`
- **tier:** `content`
- **agent emittable:** yes
- **emit:** developer, untrusted
- **group:** `data`

### Use when

- Show how groups that started at different times keep going, period by period

### Don't use when

- One trend over time: use a line chart
- Records people sort and search: use data-grid

### Accessibility

- A real table: a caption, period column headers and cohort row headers with scope
- Heat tints are decorative and contrast-safe; the number stays the cell content

### Props

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `caption` | string | yes | untrusted | — | The table caption and accessible name: what is measured and how. |
| `rows` | array | yes | — | — | Cohorts, one row each: a label, an optional size and one value per period reached (rates from 0 to 1, or counts). incomplete marks the last value as a period still in progress. |
| `periods` | array | no | — | — | Period column headers ("Month 0", "Month 1"…); missing ones are numbered. |
| `captionHidden` | boolean | no | — | `false` | — |
| `valueKind` | enum(rate | count) | no | — | `"rate"` | — |
| `heat` | boolean | no | — | `false` | — |
| `max` | number | no | — | — | Top of the heat scale (default: 1 for rates, the largest cell for counts). |
| `average` | boolean | no | — | `false` | Adds an averages row, weighted by cohort size when every cohort has one. |
| `density` | enum(compact | default | comfortable) | no | — | `"compact"` | — |
| `locale` | string | no | — | `"en-US"` | — |

### Examples

#### Monthly retention (`monthly-retention`)

```json
{
  "caption": "Share of accounts active each month after signup",
  "periods": [
    "Month 0",
    "Month 1",
    "Month 2"
  ],
  "heat": true,
  "average": true,
  "rows": [
    {
      "label": "Aug 2026",
      "size": 420,
      "cells": [
        1,
        0.62,
        0.48
      ]
    },
    {
      "label": "Sep 2026",
      "size": 380,
      "cells": [
        1,
        0.58,
        0.51
      ],
      "incomplete": true
    },
    {
      "label": "Oct 2026",
      "size": 455,
      "cells": [
        1,
        0.66
      ],
      "incomplete": true
    }
  ]
}
```

# Dashboard

> A widget grid people can rearrange: data-dashboard-widget children on columns and rows, moved and resized by drag or keyboard, reflowing on narrow screens.

- **id:** `data-dashboard`
- **package:** `@texuli/data`
- **tier:** `content`
- **agent emittable:** yes
- **emit:** developer, untrusted
- **group:** `data`

### Use when

- An overview of several views (KPIs, charts, grids bound to host data sources) people arrange themselves
- A home or operations screen whose layout should persist per person

### Don't use when

- A fixed grid of cards: use layout-grid
- One chart or one table: paint it on its own

### Accessibility

- A named region whose widgets are a list in reading order (row, then column), whatever order they were written in
- Each widget has a move handle and a resize handle: Space or Enter picks up, arrows move or resize one column or row, Space or Enter drops, Escape cancels; every step is announced with its column, row and size
- A click on a handle opens an arrange toolbar, so nothing needs a drag (WCAG 2.5.7); handles are at least 24 by 24 px
- Widgets glide to their new cell only when motion is allowed; reduced motion commits at once

### Props

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | string | yes | untrusted | — | Accessible name of the view. |
| `columns` | number | no | — | `12` | Columns of the widest grid (1 to 24). Narrower screens reflow onto at most 6 columns from 640 px and one column below. |
| `density` | enum(compact | default | comfortable) | no | — | — | — |
| `gap` | enum(none | small | medium | large) | no | — | — | — |
| `editable` | boolean | no | — | `false` | Shows the move and resize handles. |
| `compaction` | enum(vertical | none) | no | — | `"vertical"` | "vertical" floats widgets up to close gaps; "none" keeps gaps. |
| `layout` | array | no | — | — | The saved layout of the widest grid: one {id, x, y, w, h} per widget, id matching a widget's widgetId. Bind it to a list state, or read it from a host data source, to persist what people arrange; without it the widgets' own place props lay out the grid. |
| `children` | slot | no | — | — | data-dashboard-widget nodes only (at most 200). |

### Examples

#### Operations overview (`operations`)

```json
{
  "label": "Operations",
  "columns": 12,
  "editable": true
}
```

### Related

- [`data-dashboard-widget`](components/data-dashboard-widget.md)
- [`layout-grid`](components/layout-grid.md)
- [`data-grid`](components/data-grid.md)

---

_Generated from the Texuli catalog manifest. Do not hand-edit; regenerate with `@texuli/tools/llms`._

---

# Dashboard widget

> One titled widget of a data-dashboard, placed on the grid; its child is any content node, such as a chart, a KPI or a grid bound to a host data source.

- **id:** `data-dashboard-widget`
- **package:** `@texuli/data`
- **tier:** `content`
- **agent emittable:** yes
- **emit:** developer, untrusted
- **group:** `data`

### Use when

- A tile of a data-dashboard

### Don't use when

- Anywhere outside a data-dashboard: use layout-card

### Accessibility

- Its title is a heading, and it names the widget's move and resize handles
- Its content is ordinary catalog nodes: no HTML, and data only from host-registered sources

### Props

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `widgetId` | string | yes | — | — | Stable id, unique in the dashboard: letters, digits, "-" and "_", at most 64 characters. The key of this widget in every saved layout. |
| `title` | string | yes | untrusted | — | Visible title; also names the handles. |
| `place` | object | no | — | — | Where the widget starts on the widest grid when the dashboard has no saved layout for it: {x, y, w, h} in columns and rows, with optional minW, minH, maxW, maxH and locked. Without x and y it takes the first free slot. |
| `children` | slot | no | — | — | The widget content. |

### Examples

#### Revenue tile (`revenue`)

```json
{
  "widgetId": "revenue",
  "title": "Revenue",
  "place": {
    "x": 0,
    "y": 0,
    "w": 4,
    "h": 2
  }
}
```

- [`data-dashboard`](components/data-dashboard.md)

- **id:** `data-filter-builder`
- **package:** `@texuli/data`
- **tier:** `content`
- **agent emittable:** yes
- **emit:** developer, untrusted
- **group:** `data`

### Use when

- Let people compose a structured filter, such as "status is open and total over 100"

### Don't use when

- One text filter that other nodes read: use control-filter
- A fixed choice between a few views: use control-choice

### Accessibility

- Native selects and inputs, every one labelled; each group is a labelled fieldset
- Adding and removing conditions moves focus to the next control and is announced politely

### Props

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | string | yes | untrusted | — | Accessible name of the view. |
| `fields` | array | yes | — | — | The fields a condition can test; options list the values of an enum field, and optionLabels maps a value to the text its menus show (the value otherwise). |
| `value` | object | no | — | — | The starting filter: {type:"group", op:"and"\|"or", children:[{type:"condition", field, operator, value}…]}. It is checked against fields (at most 6 levels and 200 nodes); one that does not fit starts empty. |
| `maxDepth` | number | no | — | `3` | Deepest group level offered (the root is 1), capped at 5. |
| `issues` | array | no | — | — | Problems to show on conditions: each message appears under the condition at path (child indexes from the root) and marks its value control invalid. Paths that are not a condition are ignored. |
| `disabled` | boolean | no | — | `false` | — |

### Examples

#### Open orders (`open-orders`)

```json
{
  "label": "Order filter",
  "fields": [
    {
      "key": "status",
      "header": "Status",
      "type": "enum",
      "options": [
        "open",
        "closed"
      ]
    },
    {
      "key": "total",
      "header": "Total",
      "type": "number"
    }
  ],
  "value": {
    "type": "group",
    "op": "and",
    "children": [
      {
        "type": "condition",
        "field": "status",
        "operator": "eq",
        "value": "open"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

### Related

- [`data-grid`](components/data-grid.md)
- [`control-filter`](components/control-filter.md)

---

_Generated from the Texuli catalog manifest. Do not hand-edit; regenerate with `@texuli/tools/llms`._

# Data grid

> A sortable, searchable grid of rows and typed columns; virtualized for long lists.

- **id:** `data-grid`
- **package:** `@texuli/data`
- **tier:** `content`
- **agent emittable:** yes
- **emit:** developer, untrusted
- **group:** `data`

### Use when

- Show many records people sort, search and select

### Don't use when

- A small static table in a document: use table or blocks-data

### Accessibility

- A WAI-ARIA grid with a caption, sortable column headers and roving cell focus
- Sort and search changes are announced; selection is exposed per row

### Props

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `caption` | string | yes | untrusted | — | The grid caption and accessible name. |
| `columns` | array | yes | — | — | — |
| `rows` | array | yes | — | — | Rows: an id and one display string per column id (the column kind sorts it). |
| `searchable` | boolean | no | — | `false` | — |
| `selectable` | boolean | no | — | `false` | — |
| `density` | enum(compact | default | comfortable) | no | — | — | — |

### Examples

#### Orders (`orders`)

```json
{
  "caption": "Open orders",
  "columns": [
    {
      "id": "customer",
      "header": "Customer"
    },
    {
      "id": "total",
      "header": "Total",
      "kind": "number",
      "align": "end",
      "sortable": true
    }
  ],
  "rows": [
    {
      "id": "o1",
      "cells": {
        "customer": "Northwind Example",
        "total": "1240"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "o2",
      "cells": {
        "customer": "Contoso Example",
        "total": "310"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

# Notification inbox

> Notifications, newest first, with unread state, mark read and unread, mark all read and an unread view.

- **id:** `data-notification-inbox`
- **package:** `@texuli/data`
- **tier:** `content`
- **agent emittable:** yes
- **emit:** developer, untrusted
- **group:** `data`

### Use when

- List updates someone should catch up on, such as mentions or review requests

### Don't use when

- A short-lived confirmation: that is a host toast
- A history of changes without read state: use timeline

### Accessibility

- A section named by its heading; the unread count is read after it
- Every item has a read toggle named with its title; new unread items are announced politely

### Props

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | array | yes | untrusted | — | Notifications, newest first. href passes the untrusted URL policy (https, mailto and #fragments); read changes stay in view. |
| `filter` | enum(all | unread) | no | — | `"all"` | — |
| `now` | string | no | — | — | The ISO instant the time labels count from (default: when it paints). |
| `timeZone` | string | no | — | `"UTC"` | — |
| `locale` | string | no | — | `"en-US"` | — |
| `markReadOnOpen` | boolean | no | — | `true` | Opening an unread item marks it read. |
| `headingLevel` | number | no | — | `2` | Level of the inbox heading, 2 to 6. |

### Examples

#### Mentions (`mentions`)

```json
{
  "now": "2026-10-27T12:00:00Z",
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "n1",
      "title": "Ana Example mentioned you in Launch plan",
      "body": "Can you check the timeline before Friday?",
      "at": "2026-10-27T11:40:00Z",
      "read": false,
      "href": "https://example.com/docs/launch-plan"
    },
    {
      "id": "n2",
      "title": "Weekly report is ready",
      "at": "2026-10-26T09:00:00Z",
      "read": true
    }
  ]
}
```

- [`timeline`](components/timeline.md)

| `master` | enum(title | section | content | two-column | media-left | media-right | quote | closing) | no | — | — | — |
| `layout` | string | no | — | — | Catalog layout id, free, component or custom (model v2) |
| `transition` | enum(none | fade | fade-up | slide | zoom | morph) | no | — | — | — |
| `themeRef` | unknown | no | — | — | Overrides the deck theme for this slide |
| `background` | unknown | no | — | — | Slide background preset or spec (model v2) |
| `steps` | array | no | — | — | Optional step labels (names steps 1…) |
| `props` | object | no | — | — | Layout props when layout is a catalog layout id |
| `component` | object | no | — | — | Component slide payload when layout is component |
| `children` | slot | no | — | — | — |
| `class` | string | no | — | — | — |

# Dialog

> Modal dialog with title, optional description, body and footer.

- **id:** `dialog`
- **package:** `texuli`
- **tier:** `app`
- **agent emittable:** no
- **emit:** 
- **group:** `overlays`

# Document

> A block document (a brief, a report, notes or a page) as data: headings, paragraphs, lists, callouts, columns, content blocks and embedded components.

- **id:** `document`
- **package:** `@texuli/pages`
- **tier:** `content`
- **agent emittable:** yes
- **emit:** developer, untrusted
- **group:** `documents`

### Use when

- Write a document people read, export (Markdown, DOCX, PDF) or keep editing
- Edit an existing document with a bounded patch (patchDocument) instead of rewriting it

### Don't use when

- An interface with controls, state or flows: use layout-page or layout-doc with catalog nodes
- A slide presentation: use layout-deck

### Accessibility

- Painted as an article named by the document title, with anchored headings and an outline
- Text is data, never HTML; links and media pass the URL policy at the host tier
- Embedded components are validated again as catalog nodes at the same tier

### Props

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `doc` | object | yes | — | — | A Texuli document: { format: "texuli-document", formatVersion: 1, meta: { title }, blocks }. Blocks: paragraph, heading, code, list, quote, divider, media, callout, toggle, columns, page-link, block ({ family, block, props }: a @texuli/blocks block) and embed ({ kind: "component", inline: { id, props } }: one catalog node). |
| `label` | string | no | untrusted | — | Accessible name; defaults to the document title. |
| `outline` | boolean | no | — | `true` | Show the "On this page" outline when the document has two or more headings. |

### Examples

#### Project brief (`brief`)

```json
{
  "doc": {
    "format": "texuli-document",
    "formatVersion": 1,
    "meta": {
      "title": "Project brief",
      "locale": "en"
    },
    "blocks": [
      {
        "id": "title",
        "type": "heading",
        "level": 1,
        "content": [
          {
            "type": "text",
            "text": "Project brief",
            "marks": []
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": "intro",
        "type": "paragraph",
        "content": [
          {
            "type": "text",
            "text": "A fictional plan for the example.com launch.",
            "marks": []
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        "id": "risk",
        "type": "callout",
        "tone": "warning",
        "blocks": [
          {
            "id": "risk-text",
            "type": "paragraph",
            "content": [
              {
                "type": "text",
                "text": "The beta ends on Friday.",
                "marks": []
              }
            ]
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

# Form

> A form shell with layout, validation hook and error map.

- **id:** `form`
- **package:** `texuli`
- **tier:** `app`
- **agent emittable:** no
- **emit:** 
- **group:** `forms`

### Use when

- Collect and validate a set of fields before submit

### Don't use when

- A single control with no submit (use field alone)

### Accessibility

- Native constraint validation runs unless noValidate is set
- Field errors map back onto controls after onValidate

### Props

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |

| `onValidate` | event | no | — | — | Return a field→message map (or Promise) to block submit |
| `onSubmitValues` | event | no | — | — | Called after validation succeeds with FormData values |
| `errors` | object | no | — | — | Controlled field→message map (bind:errors) |
| `onErrorsChange` | event | no | — | — | — |
| `class` | string | no | — | — | — |
| `children` | slot | no | — | — | — |
| `formError` | slot | no | — | — | Form-level error snippet (e.g. _form message) |

# Host region

> Reserves a named place where the host app mounts its own component.

- **id:** `host-region`
- **package:** `@texuli/player`
- **tier:** `content`
- **agent emittable:** yes
- **emit:** developer, untrusted
- **group:** `state`

### Use when

- A step that needs sensitive input the agent must never emit (payment, sign-in)
- A place for host chrome that lives inside the document flow

### Don't use when

- Content the agent can describe itself: use a content block
- Card numbers, passwords or one-time codes as props: those never appear in a blueprint

### Accessibility

- The host component sits in a labelled group named by the label
- A region the host does not provide shows the label as visible text, not an empty box

### Props

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | yes | — | — | The region the host provides, such as "payment" (lowercase, digits, hyphens). |
| `label` | string | yes | untrusted | — | What the region is for; its accessible name and its placeholder text. |

### Examples

#### Payment step (`payment`)

```json
{
  "name": "payment",
  "label": "Payment details"
}
```

### Related

- [`layout-stack`](components/layout-stack.md)

# Inline text

> A plain text run for the slot of a slot-only component (button, label, badge).

- **id:** `inline-text`
- **package:** `@texuli/catalog`
- **tier:** `app`
- **agent emittable:** no
- **emit:** 
- **group:** `display`

### Use when

- Give a form label, description, field error or menu trigger its visible text
- Text for a button, badge or kbd when the tree prefers a child to the label prop
- Any slot that needs a short phrase rather than a block

### Don't use when

- A paragraph, heading or list (use blocks-text)
- Text that needs formatting or links (use blocks-text)
- A component that already has a label or title prop (set that prop)

### Accessibility

- Painted as one escaped text node, so it names the parent control (a button label)
- A leaf: children are dropped

### Props

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | string | yes | — | — | Plain text; the renderer refuses markup-like strings |

### Examples

#### Button label (`button-label`)

```json
{
  "text": "Save changes"
}
```

#### Badge word (`badge-word`)

```json
{
  "text": "Shipped"
}
```

### Related

- [`button`](components/button.md)
- [`label`](components/label.md)
- [`badge`](components/badge.md)
- [`kbd`](components/kbd.md)

_Generated from the Texuli catalog manifest. Do not hand-edit; regenerate with `@texuli/tools/llms`._

# Row layout

> Children side by side, wrapping onto new lines when space runs out.

- **id:** `layout-row`
- **package:** `texuli`
- **tier:** `content`
- **agent emittable:** yes
- **emit:** developer, untrusted
- **group:** `composition`

### Use when

- Place a few items next to each other, such as KPIs or actions

### Don't use when

- App chrome shells (sidebar, top-nav, dialogs)

### Accessibility

- DOM order stays reading order; the layout never reorders children visually
- Logical properties only, so right-to-left content mirrors

### Props

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `gap` | enum(none | small | medium | large) | no | — | — | Space between children. |
| `align` | enum(start | center | end | stretch) | no | — | — | — |
| `wrap` | boolean | no | — | `true` | — |
| `children` | slot | no | — | — | — |

### Examples

#### Row (`basic`)

```json
{
  "gap": "small",
  "align": "center"
}
```

- [`layout-stack`](components/layout-stack.md)
- [`layout-grid`](components/layout-grid.md)

# MultiSelect

> A combobox for several values, shown as removable chips.

- **id:** `multi-select`
- **package:** `texuli`
- **tier:** `app`
- **agent emittable:** no
- **emit:** 
- **group:** `forms`

### Use when

- Choose several values from a long list by typing

### Don't use when

- One value (use combobox or select)
- A few independent options (use checkbox)

### Accessibility

- Chips can be removed with their button or Backspace from an empty input
- Submits one form entry per selected value

### Props

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | unknown | no | — | — | Selected value (a string, or a string array when multiple) |
| `defaultValue` | unknown | no | — | — | Starting selection; a form reset restores it |
| `inputValue` | string | no | — | — | Text in the input (bindable) |
| `defaultInputValue` | string | no | — | `""` | — |
| `items` | array | no | — | — | Options as { value, label, disabled? } |
| `loadOptions` | unknown | no | — | — | Function prop the host passes: (query, signal) => Promise<items> for remote options. Not agent-emittable (functions are not data). |
| `filter` | unknown | no | — | — | Function prop the host passes: (item, query) => boolean. Replaces the default match (label contains the query, ignoring case); runs on the trimmed, non-empty query; unused with loadOptions. createFoldedFilter builds an accent-insensitive one. Not agent-emittable (functions are not data). |
| `disabled` | boolean | no | — | `false` | Not interactive, not submitted, not validated |
| `name` | string | no | — | — | Form field name: submits the value (one entry per value when multiple) |
| `required` | boolean | no | — | `false` | Blocks form submission until a value is selected |
| `requiredMessage` | string | no | — | — | Translated message when required blocks submission (default: the browser message) |
| `form` | string | no | — | — | Associated form id |
| `open` | boolean | no | — | `false` | — |
| `size` | enum(sm | md | lg) | no | — | `"md"` | — |
| `variant` | enum(outline | soft) | no | — | `"outline"` | — |
| `class` | string | no | — | — | — |
| `onValueChange` | event | no | — | — | — |
| `onInputValueChange` | event | no | — | — | — |
| `onOpenChange` | event | no | — | — | — |
| `children` | slot | no | — | — | — |

### Examples

#### Tags field (`tags`)

```json
{
  "name": "tags",
  "variant": "outline",
  "size": "md"
}
```

### Related

- [`combobox`](components/combobox.md)

- **id:** `popover`

- **tier:** `app`
- **agent emittable:** no
- **emit:** 
- **group:** `overlays`

### Use when

- Lightweight detail next to a control
- Pickers that are not full dialogs

### Don't use when

- Modal workflows (use dialog)
- Single-line hints (use tooltip)

### Accessibility

- Focus can move into the panel; Escape dismisses.

### Props

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` | boolean | no | — | `false` | — |
| `onOpenChange` | event | no | — | — | — |
| `children` | slot | no | — | — | — |

### Examples

#### Open popover (`open`)

```json
{
  "open": true
}
```

# Schema form

> A whole form as data: typed fields in sections or steps, conditional logic, named formats and cross-field rules, painted with texuli controls; submitting proposes one action intent to the host.

- **id:** `schema-form`
- **package:** `@texuli/forms`
- **tier:** `content`
- **agent emittable:** yes
- **emit:** developer, untrusted
- **group:** `schema-forms`

### Use when

- Collect structured answers: registrations, requests, surveys, intake and settings
- A multi-step flow with per-step validation, or fields that appear, become required or become editable from earlier answers

### Don't use when

- One or two values for an action: use action-form with form-field
- Payment, passwords or one-time codes: use a host-region
- A filter bar over data: use control-filter or data-filter-builder

### Accessibility

- A form landmark named by its title; every control is a texuli control with a visible label, its description and its error linked
- Errors are announced, an error summary takes focus and links to each field; each new step heading takes focus and is announced
- Keyboard-complete: native order, Enter moves to the next step or submits; reduced motion makes step transitions instant

### Props

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `schema` | object | yes | — | — | The form: { title, description?, submitLabel?, fields \| sections \| steps, rules? }. Field types: text, textarea, number, email, url, date, time, select, multiselect, checkbox, radio, switch, slider, file (host-handled), tags. Rules: required, minLength, maxLength, min, max, step, minItems, maxItems, a named format (email, url, phone, postal-code…, never a pattern) and validator (a name the host registered). when.show / require / enable are expressions over earlier fields; rules[] are cross-field expressions that fail when false. |
| `action` | string | yes | — | — | The action name the host receives with the submitted values. |
| `label` | string | no | untrusted | — | Accessible name; defaults to the form title. |

### Examples

#### Access request (`request`)

```json
{
  "action": "request-access",
  "schema": {
    "title": "Request access",
    "submitLabel": "Send request",
    "fields": [
      {
        "name": "email",
        "type": "email",
        "label": "Work email",
        "required": true
      },
      {
        "name": "team",
        "type": "select",
        "label": "Team",
        "required": true,
        "options": [
          {
            "value": "design",
            "label": "Design"
          },
          {
            "value": "engineering",
            "label": "Engineering"
          }
        ]
      },
      {
        "name": "reason",
        "type": "textarea",
        "label": "Why do you need access?",
        "maxLength": 500,
        "when": {
          "require": {
            "op": "eq",
            "left": {
              "op": "field",
              "name": "team"
            },
            "right": {
              "op": "str",
              "value": "engineering"
            }
          }
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

### Related

- [`action-form`](components/action-form.md)
- [`form-field`](components/form-field.md)
- [`layout-wizard`](components/layout-wizard.md)

# Select

> A single-value select root with size and variant chrome.

- **id:** `select`
- **package:** `texuli`
- **tier:** `app`
- **agent emittable:** no
- **emit:** 
- **group:** `forms`

### Use when

- Pick one value from a moderate closed list

### Don't use when

- A short exclusive set that fits on the page (use radio-group)
- Free text with suggestions (use combobox)

### Accessibility

- Trigger is a real button; listbox opens on ArrowDown/Enter/Space
- Typeahead highlights matching items; Escape closes and restores focus

### Props

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `open` | boolean | no | — | `false` | — |
| `value` | string | no | — | — | — |
| `defaultValue` | string | no | — | — | — |
| `name` | string | no | — | — | — |
| `disabled` | boolean | no | — | `false` | — |
| `required` | boolean | no | — | `false` | — |
| `form` | string | no | — | — | Associated form id |

| `items` | array | no | — | — | Optional value/label catalog when items are not registered by Select.Item |
| `sideOffset` | number | no | — | `4` | — |
| `positioning` | boolean | no | — | `true` | — |
| `size` | enum(sm | md | lg) | no | — | `"md"` | — |
| `variant` | enum(outline | soft) | no | — | `"outline"` | — |
| `onOpenChange` | event | no | — | — | — |
| `onValueChange` | event | no | — | — | — |
| `children` | slot | no | — | — | — |

# Sheet

> Edge-anchored modal panel (drawer-like sheet).

- **id:** `sheet`
- **package:** `texuli`
- **tier:** `app`
- **agent emittable:** no
- **emit:** 
- **group:** `overlays`

### Use when

- Mobile filters, detail rails, edge panels

### Don't use when

- Centered modal forms (use dialog)

### Accessibility

- Focus trapped while open; Escape dismisses.

### Props

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | enum(sm | md | lg | xl) | no | — | `"md"` | — |
| `side` | enum(top | right | bottom | left | start | end | center) | no | — | `"start"` | — |
| `modal` | boolean | no | — | `true` | false: a non-modal panel (no focus trap, inert or scroll lock) |
| `dismissOutside` | boolean | no | — | `false` | Non-modal only: close on a press or focus outside (never on the trigger) |
| `closeOnEscape` | boolean | no | — | `false` | Non-modal only: close on Escape anywhere, not just from inside |
| `class` | string | no | — | — | — |
| `children` | slot | no | — | — | — |

### Examples

#### Start edge (`start`)

```json
{
  "side": "start",
  "size": "md"
}
```

# Sortable list

> A list whose items are a bound list variable; people reorder it by drag or keyboard, and lists sharing a group exchange items.

- **id:** `sortable-list`
- **package:** `@texuli/player`
- **tier:** `content`
- **agent emittable:** yes
- **emit:** developer, untrusted
- **group:** `state`

### Use when

- Let people rank, reorder or move items between lists (priorities, backlog columns)
- Drag as data: the order is the list variable, so other nodes read it

### Don't use when

- A read-only list: use blocks-structure
- Cards between board columns with work-in-progress limits: use data-board

### Accessibility

- A labelled list of items, each with a drag handle button; Space or Enter picks up, arrows move, Space or Enter drops, Escape cancels
- Every move has a non-drag path (keyboard) and is announced politely; reduced motion disables the move animation

### Props

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | string | yes | untrusted | — | Accessible name. |
| `reorder` | object | yes | — | — | Drag as data: bind (a $state list), axis, group, accepts, locked, pull and disabled. |
| `itemLabel` | string | no | — | `"label"` | The item field shown as each item’s text. |
| `itemDetail` | string | no | — | — | An item field shown as secondary text. |

### Examples

#### Priorities (`priorities`)

```json
{
  "label": "This week",
  "reorder": {
    "bind": {
      "$state": "priorities"
    },
    "axis": "vertical"
  }
}
```

### Related

- [`data-board`](components/data-board.md)
- [`blocks-structure`](components/blocks-structure.md)

---

_Generated from the Texuli catalog manifest. Do not hand-edit; regenerate with `@texuli/tools/llms`._

# Spreadsheet

> A spreadsheet as data: tabs of cells holding numbers, text, booleans and formulas that recalculate.

- **id:** `spreadsheet`
- **package:** `@texuli/sheets`
- **tier:** `content`
- **agent emittable:** yes
- **emit:** developer, untrusted
- **group:** `sheets`

### Use when

- A budget, an estimate, a price list or a tracker whose totals people keep editing
- Numbers that depend on other numbers through formulas (SUM, IF, VLOOKUP, DATE…)

### Don't use when

- Read-only records with typed columns, sorting and search: use data-grid
- A chart of values: use a chart family
- A form people fill in once: use schema-form

### Accessibility

- Painted as an APG grid with column letters, row numbers and one tab stop
- Values are text, never HTML; formulas are a closed language with no references built from text and no network
- A formula error shows its code in the cell (#DIV/0!, #REF!, #CYCLE!…)

### Props

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sheet` | object | yes | — | — | A Texuli sheet: { format: "texuli-sheet", formatVersion: 1, meta: { title }, sheets: [{ id, name, rows, columns, cells }] }. cells maps A1 addresses ("B3") to a number, a boolean, text, or a formula that starts with "=" ("=SUM(B1:B2)", "=IF(C2>100, \"high\", \"low\")", "=Rates!A1*B2"). About 50 functions: SUM, AVERAGE, MIN, MAX, COUNT, COUNTA, ROUND, SUMIF, COUNTIF, IF, IFS, AND, OR, IFERROR, CONCAT, LEFT, TEXT, INDEX, MATCH, VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, DATE, TODAY and more. No INDIRECT, OFFSET or RAND. Dates are "YYYY-MM-DD" text. Text that must start with "=" is written "'=…". At most 16 sheets, 10,000 rows, 256 columns and 100,000 cells. |
| `label` | string | no | untrusted | — | Accessible name; defaults to the sheet title. |

### Examples

#### Team offsite budget (`budget`)

```json
{
  "sheet": {
    "format": "texuli-sheet",
    "formatVersion": 1,
    "meta": {
      "title": "Team offsite budget"
    },
    "sheets": [
      {
        "id": "costs",
        "name": "Costs",
        "rows": 8,
        "columns": 4,
        "cells": {
          "A1": "Item",
          "B1": "Unit cost",
          "C1": "Quantity",
          "D1": "Total",
          "A2": "Venue",
          "B2": 1200,
          "C2": 1,
          "D2": "=B2*C2",
          "A3": "Lunch",
          "B3": 18.5,
          "C3": 24,
          "D3": "=B3*C3",
          "A4": "Coffee",
          "B4": 3.25,
          "C4": 48,
          "D4": "=B4*C4",
          "A6": "Total",
          "D6": "=SUM(D2:D4)",
          "A7": "Over budget?",
          "D7": "=IF(D6>2000, \"yes\", \"no\")"
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

### Related

- [`data-grid`](components/data-grid.md)
- [`document`](components/document.md)

---

_Generated from the Texuli catalog manifest. Do not hand-edit; regenerate with `@texuli/tools/llms`._

# TimeField

> A labelled time of day typed or stepped by segment (hour, minute, AM/PM), with a 24-hour HH:mm value.

- **id:** `time-field`
- **package:** `texuli`
- **tier:** `app`
- **agent emittable:** no
- **emit:** 
- **group:** `forms`

### Use when

- A time of day on its own, such as a reminder or an opening hour

### Don't use when

- A date, or a date and time (use the date pickers)
- A duration (use a number field)

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |

| `error` | string | no | — | — | Error text; also marks the field invalid |
| `value` | string | no | — | — | The time as HH:mm (24-hour), or null when empty (bind:value) |
| `onValueChange` | event | no | — | — | — |
| `locale` | string | no | — | `"en-US"` | — |
| `hourCycle` | number | no | — | — | 12 shows AM/PM, 24 does not; default the locale cycle |
| `minuteStep` | number | no | — | `1` | Minutes the arrow keys move on the minute segment |
| `disabled` | boolean | no | — | `false` | — |
| `required` | boolean | no | — | `false` | — |
| `name` | string | no | — | — | Form field name: submits the value |
| `size` | enum(sm | md) | no | — | `"md"` | — |
| `labels` | object | no | — | — | Segment names (hour, minute, dayPeriod) for translation |
| `class` | string | no | — | — | — |

### Examples

#### Reminder time (`reminder`)

```json
{
  "label": "Reminder",
```

- Let people build or change a workflow, bound to a workflow state variable

### Don't use when

- A static diagram in a document: use blocks-diagram
- Quantities flowing between stages: use charts-sankey

### Accessibility

- View mode: a figure whose nodes are a list that says where each one leads
- Edit mode: focusable nodes with spatial arrow keys, keyboard connect mode on ports, and a treegrid outline that edits without the canvas
- Labels are text; links and images pass the untrusted URL policy

### Props

| Name | Kind | Required | Trust | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | string | yes | untrusted | — | Accessible name. |
| `graph` | object | yes | — | — | A spec WorkflowGraph (version 1): nodeTypes, nodes, edges, groups, cycles. |
| `mode` | enum(view | edit) | no | — | `"view"` | — |
| `flow` | enum(LR | TB) | no | — | `"LR"` | — |

### Examples

#### Expense approval (`approval`)

```json
{
  "label": "Expense approval",
  "mode": "view",
  "graph": {
    "version": 1,
    "cycles": "forbid",
    "nodeTypes": [
      {
        "id": "step",
        "label": "Step",
        "ports": [
          {
            "id": "in",
            "direction": "in"
          },
          {
            "id": "out",
            "direction": "out",
            "multiple": true
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "nodes": [
      {
        "id": "ask",
        "type": "step",
        "label": "Request",
        "position": {
          "x": 0,
          "y": 0
        }
      },
      {
        "id": "review",
        "type": "step",
        "label": "Review",
        "position": {
          "x": 260,
          "y": 0
        }
      },
      {
        "id": "paid",
        "type": "step",
        "label": "Paid",
        "position": {
          "x": 520,
          "y": 0
        }
      }
    ],
    "edges": [
      {
        "id": "e1",
        "from": {
          "node": "ask",
          "port": "out"
        },
        "to": {
          "node": "review",
          "port": "in"
        }
      },
      {
        "id": "e2",
        "from": {
          "node": "review",
          "port": "out"
        },
        "to": {
          "node": "paid",
          "port": "in"
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```
